attr.title: ShiningSource
attr.desc: Native ARM64 port of Shining Soul II (GBA) built from its decompilation: Flat 4:3 picture at 2x, every core, DRM triple buffering. Version 0.9.6.
attr.inst: Copy your own unmodified European Shining Soul II cartridge dump (AU2P) to ports/shiningsource/roms/rom.gba.
